name: cs-ai-saas-backend
description: Backend SaaS CS AI WhatsApp — 3 service terpisah (api, worker, wa-gateway)

scripts.build:libs: npm run build -w @cs-ai/shared-types && npm run build -w @cs-ai/groq-client && npm run build -w @cs-ai/database
scripts.build: npm run build:libs && npm run build -w cs-ai-api && npm run build -w cs-ai-worker && npm run build -w cs-ai-wa-gateway
scripts.predev: node -e "const{execSync}=require('child_process');const net=require('net');function log(m){console.log(m)}function warn(m){console.warn('[WARN] '+m)}async function waitPort(h,port,t=10000){const s=Date.now();while(Date.now()-s<t){try{await new Promise((res,rej)=>{const c=net.createConnection({host:h,port},()=>{c.end();res()});c.on('error',rej);setTimeout(()=>{c.destroy();rej(new Error('timeout'))},600)});log('[predev] Redis ready on '+h+':'+port);return true}catch{}await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,500))}warn('Redis port '+port+' belum ready setelah '+(t/1000)+'s - lanjutkan, cek log service.');return false}(async()=>{try{execSync('docker info',{stdio:'ignore'})}catch{warn('[predev] Docker Desktop belum aktif. Buka Docker Desktop manual jika butuh Redis.');process.exit(0)}let needWait=true;try{const st=execSync('docker inspect -f {{.State.Running}} redis-local',{encoding:'utf8'}).trim();if(st==='true'){log('[predev] redis-local sudah running');}else{execSync('docker start redis-local',{stdio:'ignore'});log('[predev] docker start redis-local OK');}}catch{try{execSync('docker run -d --name redis-local -p 6379:6379 redis:alpine',{stdio:'ignore'});log('[predev] docker run redis-local OK');}catch(e){const m=(e.message||'').toString();if(m.includes('already in use')||m.includes('already exists')){try{execSync('docker start redis-local',{stdio:'ignore'});log('[predev] docker start redis-local OK (after exists)');}catch(e2){warn('Gagal start redis-local: '+(e2.message||e2));needWait=false;}}else{warn('Gagal buat/start redis-local: '+(e.message||e));needWait=false;}}}if(needWait) await waitPort('127.0.0.1',6379,10000);process.exit(0)})()"
scripts.dev: npm run build:libs && concurrently -k --restart-tries 0 --handle-input false -n api,worker,wa "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:worker" "npm run dev:wa"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:libs && ./node_modules/.bin/tsc --noEmit -p apps/api/tsconfig.json && ./node_modules/.bin/tsc --noEmit -p apps/worker/tsconfig.json && ./node_modules/.bin/tsc --noEmit -p apps/wa-gateway/tsconfig.json
